user.title: Set up Irrigation Automation
user.description: Select sensors, weather forecast, valve and runtime entity. Default profile: sunny flower bed.

reconfigure.title: Change data sources
reconfigure.description: Change weather sensors, forecast or valve assignment. Saving stops any running watering operation. Settings and the winter lock are retained. The optional reset removes only this integration's weather history.

error.invalid_entity: Select an entity with the required domain.
error.entity_unavailable: The entity is missing or currently unavailable.
error.invalid_temperature: A finite temperature in °C, °F or K is required.
error.invalid_rain: A non-negative daily precipitation total in mm, cm, m or in is required.
error.invalid_number: The runtime entity does not provide a valid number.
error.hourly_forecast_required: This weather entity does not support hourly forecasts.
error.invalid_forecast: No usable hourly temperature and precipitation forecast in the next 12 hours. Please try again later.
error.cannot_stop: The current operation could not be stopped or saved safely. Check the previous valve and logs. Assignments have not been changed.
